properties.description: SOCRadar Hunting Query 5
SOCRadarCriticalAlarmDetection_AnalyticalRules Analytics Rule with template version 3.0.2

Detects SOCRadar alarms with High or Critical severity levels that require immediate attention. These alarms typically indicate active threats such as credential exposure, ransomware mentions, or targeted attacks against the organization.

properties.description: SOCRadarAlarmVolumeSpike_AnalyticalRules Analytics Rule with template version 3.0.2

Detects unusual spikes in SOCRadar alarm volume that may indicate an active campaign, coordinated attack, or data breach. Triggers when the count of one alarm type in the last hour exceeds the 7-day hourly average of that type by more than 3x and is above 5.
properties.query:
let baseline = SOCRadar_Alarms_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d) and TimeGenerated < ago(1h)
| summarize AvgHourly = count() / 168.0 by AlarmMainType;
SOCRadar_Alarms_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1h)
| summarize RecentCount = count() by AlarmMainType
| join kind=leftouter baseline on AlarmMainType
| extend BaselineAvg = coalesce(AvgHourly, 0.0)
| where RecentCount > (BaselineAvg * 3) and RecentCount > 5
| extend SpikeRatio = iff(BaselineAvg > 0, round(RecentCount / BaselineAvg, 2), real(null))
| extend timestamp = now()
| extend AccountName = AlarmMainType

properties.description: SOCRadar Analytics Rule 2
SOCRadarUnsyncedClosedIncident_AnalyticalRules Analytics Rule with template version 3.0.2

properties.description: Raises one alert, and one incident, for every OPEN SOCRadar lookalike or phishing domain alarm in SOCRadar_Alarms_CL. The phishing domain is the DNS entity; the monitored asset is a custom detail, not an entity.
properties.query:
// One alert per alarm. The platform runs a rule about 6 minutes behind the clock, so an alert is
// invisible to the very next run unless runs are far enough apart: runs are 10 minutes apart and a
// row is held back until it is 12 minutes old, which lets the previous alert show up here first.
// Alarms that already have an alert are dropped, so a late run cannot alert twice and an incident
// closed by an analyst is not followed by a second one. Custom Details is a second, still-encoded
// JSON string with 1-element arrays (live-measured). isfuzzy keeps the rule alive in a workspace
// where SecurityAlert does not exist yet.
let Alerted = union isfuzzy=true (datatable(ExtendedProperties:string)[]), SecurityAlert
| extend AlertedAlarmId = tostring(parse_json(tostring(parse_json(tostring(ExtendedProperties))['Custom Details'])).AlarmId[0])
| where isnotempty(AlertedAlarmId)
| distinct AlertedAlarmId;
SOCRadar_Alarms_CL
| where ingestion_time() > ago(1d)
| where ingestion_time() < ago(12m)
| where toupper(Status) == "OPEN"
| where isnotempty(AlarmId)
| join kind=leftanti Alerted on $left.AlarmId == $right.AlertedAlarmId
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by AlarmId
| extend AlarmUrl = strcat("https://platform.socradar.com/app/company/", CompanyId, "/alarm-management?tab=approved&field=alarmId&operator=equals&value=", AlarmId)
| extend SentinelSeverity = case(toupper(Severity) in ("CRITICAL", "HIGH"), "High", toupper(Severity) == "MEDIUM", "Medium", "Low")
// One label per alarm: case() is first-match, and every rule carries this text byte for byte, so no
// alarm is picked by two rules and a type that no branch names lands in "Other".
| extend AlarmCategory = case(
    (AlarmMainType =~ "Brand Protection" and AlarmSubType =~ "Impersonating Domain")
      or (AlarmMainType =~ "Phishing Domain" and AlarmSubType =~ "State Change"), "Phishing",
    AlarmMainType in~ ("Vulnerability Monitoring", "Vulnerability Intelligence"), "Vulnerability",
    AlarmSubType in~ ("Stolen Credentials On Dark Web Bot Market", "Black Market Botnet Detection"), "Credential",
    AlarmSubType in~ ("PII Exposure", "Dark Web Suspicious Content", "IM Platform Suspicious Content", "Code Repository Data Leak", "Public Storage Leak", "Malware Analysis Service Monitoring"), "DataLeak",
    "Other")
| where AlarmCategory == "Phishing"
| extend MonitoredAsset = tostring(AlarmPayload['alarm_asset'])
// The phishing domain is the only DNS entity; the monitored asset (the customer's own brand) is a
// custom detail, never an entity. The domain comes from the "Phishing Domain:" line of the alarm text
// (254 of the 271 research alarms name one; 17 State Change alarms name none), falling back to the
// phishing_domain payload key.
// The import regex IoCDomain1 is alphabetical and a name server or other infrastructure host on 58% of
// lookalike alarms, so it is not used here.
| extend SuspiciousDomain = tolower(trim_end(@"[.,;]+", coalesce(extract(@"Phishing Domain:\s*([^\s,;]+\.[^\s,;]+)", 1, AlarmText), tostring(AlarmPayload['phishing_domain']))))
| extend SuspiciousDomainLabel = coalesce(SuspiciousDomain, "n/a")
| extend SuspiciousIp = extract(@"([0-9]{1,3}(?:\.[0-9]{1,3}){3})", 1, tostring(AlarmPayload['ip_address']))
| extend PhishingScore = tostring(AlarmPayload['score']), PhishingKeyword = tostring(AlarmPayload['phishing_keyword'])
| extend IoCUrl1 = iff(IoCUrl1 has "socradar.com", "", IoCUrl1)
| extend AlarmContent = pack('Suspicious Domain', SuspiciousDomain, 'Suspicious IP', SuspiciousIp, 'Score', PhishingScore, 'Asset', AlarmPayload['alarm_asset'], 'Tags', AlarmPayload['tags'])
| mv-apply ContentKey = bag_keys(AlarmContent) to typeof(string) on (
    extend RawValue = trim(@"\s", replace_string(replace_string(tostring(AlarmContent[ContentKey]), "\r", ""), "\n", " "))
    | where isnotempty(RawValue) and RawValue !in ("[]", "{}", "null", "\"\"")
    | extend CellValue = case(
        RawValue startswith "[\"", replace_string(replace_string(replace_string(replace_string(RawValue, "[\"", ""), "\"]", ""), "\",\"", ", "), "\"", ""),
        RawValue startswith "{\"" or RawValue startswith "[{", replace_string(replace_string(replace_string(replace_string(replace_string(replace_string(replace_string(replace_string(replace_string(replace_string(replace_string(RawValue, "[{", ""), "}]", ""), "},{", " / "), "\",\"", "; "), "\":\"", ": "), "\":", ": "), "\",", "; "), ",\"", "; "), "\"", ""), "{", ""), "}", ""),
        RawValue)
    | summarize ContentRows = make_list(strcat(replace_string(ContentKey, "_", " "), ": ", iff(strlen(CellValue) > 160, strcat(substring(CellValue, 0, 160), "..."), CellValue))))
| extend ContentMarkdown = iff(array_length(ContentRows) == 0, "", strcat(substring(strcat("Content:\n\n", strcat_array(array_slice(ContentRows, 0, 5), "\n\n")), 0, 2600), "\n\n"))
| extend DetailsMarkdown = trim(@"\s", replace_string(replace_string(substring(AlarmText, 0, 1500), "\r", ""), "\n", " "))
| extend DetailsMarkdown = strcat(substring(DetailsMarkdown, 0, 1500), iff(strlen(AlarmText) > 1500 or strlen(DetailsMarkdown) > 1500, "...", ""))
| extend DescriptionBody = strcat("SOCRadar Alarm\n\nAlarm ID: ", AlarmId, "\n\nMain Type: ", coalesce(AlarmMainType, "N/A"), "\n\nSub Type: ", coalesce(AlarmSubType, "N/A"), "\n\nSeverity: ", Severity, "\n\nStatus: ", Status, "\n\nCreated: ", AlarmDate, "\n\nDetails:\n", coalesce(DetailsMarkdown, "No details"), "\n\n", ContentMarkdown, "\n\nSOCRadar severity: ", toupper(Severity))
| extend DescriptionLink = strcat("\n\nView in SOCRadar: ", AlarmUrl)
| extend BodyBytes = strlen(base64_encode_tostring(DescriptionBody)) * 3 / 4, BodyBudget = 4800 - 2 * strlen(DescriptionLink)
| extend AlarmDescription = strcat(iff(BodyBytes > BodyBudget, strcat(substring(DescriptionBody, 0, toint(strlen(DescriptionBody) * 1.0 * BodyBudget / BodyBytes) - 10), "..."), DescriptionBody), DescriptionLink)
| extend AlarmDescription = iff(strlen(base64_encode_tostring(AlarmDescription)) * 3 / 4 > 4900, strcat(substring(DescriptionBody, 0, 1000), "...", DescriptionLink), AlarmDescription)
| project TimeGenerated, AlarmId, CompanyId, Title, AlarmText, AlarmDescription, AlarmMainType, AlarmSubType, Severity, Status, AlarmDate, AlarmUrl, SentinelSeverity, AlarmCategory, MonitoredAsset, SuspiciousDomain, SuspiciousDomainLabel, SuspiciousIp, PhishingScore, PhishingKeyword
| order by TimeGenerated asc
| take 149

metadata.title: SOCRadar-IOC-Enrichment
metadata.description: Enriches Microsoft Sentinel incident entities (IP, domain, URL, file hash) with SOCRadar IOC Enrichment intelligence (risk score, signal strength, categorization, threat actors). Triggers on incident creation, queries the SOCRadar indicator_details API, and posts an enrichment comment to the incident. For SOCRadar-Alarm-Import incidents that carry no Microsoft Sentinel entities, it fetches the original alarm's related entities from SOCRadar by alarm id. Handles not-found (404), async (202), and benign indicators gracefully.
